name: Pixel vs Zombies
author: Vitor Lorençone
description: A Plants vs. Zombies-inspired game: place plants to hold back the zombies across 3 levels, with 5 plants and 3 zombie types. Mouse or touch to select and plant.

descriptions.en: A Plants vs. Zombies-inspired game: place plants to hold back the zombies across 3 levels, with 5 plants and 3 zombie types. Mouse or touch to select and plant.
descriptions.it: Ispirato a Plants vs. Zombies: pianta le tue difese per fermare gli zombi in 3 livelli, con 5 piante e 3 tipi di zombi. Mouse o tocco per scegliere e piantare.
